title: Near-isometric local parametrizations of an embedded C¹ submanifold
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let M ⊆ ℝ^P satisfy IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 n M (embedded n-dimensional C¹ submanifold), let z ∈ M and ε > 0. Then there are χ : ℝ^n → ℝ^P and δ, δ' > 0 such that χ(0) = z; (1 − ε)|a − b| ≤ |χ(a) − χ(b)| ≤ (1 + ε)|a − b| for all a, b ∈ B_δ(0) ⊆ ℝ^n; χ(B_δ(0)) ⊆ M; and M ∩ B_{δ'}(z) ⊆ χ(B_δ(0)).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (z : Euclid P), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 n M → z ∈ M → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ (χ : Euclid n → Euclid P) (δ δ' : ℝ), 0 < δ ∧ 0 < δ' ∧ χ 0 = z ∧ (∀ a ∈ ball (0 : Euclid n) δ, ∀ b ∈ ball (0 : Euclid n) δ, (1 - ε) * ‖a - b‖ ≤ ‖χ a - χ b‖ ∧ ‖χ a - χ b‖ ≤ (1 + ε) * ‖a - b‖) ∧ χ '' ball 0 δ ⊆ M ∧ M ∩ ball z δ' ⊆ χ '' ball 0 δ
